title: Mallworld Visitor Analytics Survey
content: Hi there, I have some theories on the possible reasons why we see these places when we dream, and I’ve created a short survey to gather some data to help me sort through these possible explanations, anyone who is interested can take this quick questionnaire and depending on the results I plan to do a follow up post once I’ve gathered a good bit of data. https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeS4mHOJFwwoLdXMEkQBfDWPybsTK3TCDDR8iih6k-LTEQZCQ/viewform?usp=sf_link If there are any additional questions you have please let me know, I plan to leave this open for the next week or so before tallying the results.
